name: The Ladder of Mríddu the Magician

system.description:
Folds to the size of a hand (six ounces) and unfolds into a ladder over 50 feet long holding six men; tiny claws at the top hold it fast until released. Reusable.

How many exist: said to be three. Never for sale, though one may sometimes be borrowed from a temple or the Imperium for a mission.
